name: Emery Rahman
life: “I still remember buying warm milk for a child who wanted cold.” Sunday often includes a stop at the bank steps, where Emery takes a few minutes to read the public notices, especially the ones written in a hurry.
voice: I took the long road and discovered where my daughter has breakfast before school.
appearance: Emery is easy to recognize by a blunt cut just below the ears and a round face with a pronounced chin. Usually dressed in an olive canvas jacket with a tiny red thread tied through the lowest buttonhole, Emery rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket when listening.
personality: Emery can be lavish with time and quite careful with cash. A free afternoon is sometimes the biggest gift Emery can afford to give, and family knows to take it seriously.
agenda: To share breakfast at the daughter's newly discovered stop.
family: Aria Miller is Emery’s second cousin. Emery chooses an ordinary story to tell. Aria asks the question the rest of the family avoided. They tend to get further with an important subject when it arrives in the middle of talk about dinner or work. Asked about *The understudy sings*, Aria says, “I want to sing the harmony with my sister once more while she can hear the lower note.”
connections: Jo Briggs. Breakfast and a family lift turn a delayed route into a pair of personal calls.
